parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description: The license plate recognition feature currently supports the Shanghai and Shenzhen regions. If you selected the Shanghai region when activating the service, use OSS links in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~). If you selected the Shenzhen region when activating the service, only OSS links in the Shenzhen region are supported.
